items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Yeah, Francois Mosley's band. Charlie Ducasse, myself, Fred Reed on piano.

ctx.x: Oh, I wanted to ask you about Frankie Halfpaint Jackson. You made a record with him, huh? Oh, yeah. I made a record with him. You remember who was in that band?

Yeah, Francois Mosley's band. Charlie Ducasse, myself, Fred Reed on piano. And Charlie Ducasse on guitar and that boy, Lil Sax on tenor. Fred Howard on alto. He played alto on clarinet. And what else? Fred on piano, me on trumpet. Al Wynn on trombone. Al Wynn. I got a letter from him the other day. Little Sax's name is what? Robert Crowder. Everybody called him. You know who he was, Kenta? Y'all didn't know Cecil. He used to play with Earl Hein.
